IC1: Type 1 diabetes according to ADA criterias <5 years.
IC2: Age= 18 years and less than 70 years.
IC3: No[NOT] n-obese: defined as BMI less than 28 kg/m2
IC4: Positive for at least one of the anti-islet autoantibodies: GADA, I [OR]A2A, Z [OR]nT8A
IC5: Fasting or  [OR]postprandial plasma C-peptide more than 100 pmol/L
IC6: Written informed consent from the patient or family representative.
